messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user is asking for an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I should create a playful, decent SVG illustration. Let me think about the composition.

Elements:
- Bicycle: two wheels with spokes, frame, handlebars, seat, pedals
- Pelican: big body, long beak with a pouch, round head, eye, wing (one wing on the handlebar), legs on the pedals, webbed feet
- It'd be nice to have background too: sun, ground line, clouds

Layout plan: canvas 600x400. Ground at y=340. Wheels: rear wheel center (180, 300) r=50, front wheel center (420, 300) r=50. Frame: connect with lines. Seatpost around x=230, seat at (230, 225). Head tube at x=400ish, handlebar at (410, 200). Pelican sits on the seat: torso as ellipse at (250, 180), head at (300, 120), beak extending forward and down to near handlebar (370, 150). Wing from shoulder (~300, 150) reaching to handlebar (410, 200). Legs from bottom of torso (~250, 220) down to pedal at crank center (300, 290).

Crank at bottom bracket (300, 295). Chain optional.

Add details: white torso, orange beak, eye, wing lines, wheel spokes.

Let me write out the SVG. Use simple shapes and paths.

Frame coordinates:
- Rear wheel hub R=(180,300), front wheel hub F=(420,300), BB=(295,295)
- Seat top S=(235,220); seatpost from BB to S, and chainstay from R to BB, seat tube from BB to S.
- Down tube from BB to head tube H=(400,215); top tube from S to H.
- Fork from H to F.
- Handlebar at H: small horizontal bar.

Wheels: circle with dark stroke, inner circle (rims). Spokes as lines.

Pelican:
- Body: ellipse cx=250 cy=185 rx=45 ry=35, white with gray stroke.
- Tail: small triangle on the rear left side.
- Neck/head: head circle cx=305 cy=125 r=22.
- Beak: long path from head to the right: upper mandible from (315,118) to (395,140); pouch curve below (dip to y~165) returning to (315,138). Orange.
- Eye: black circle at (310, 120), with white highlight.
- Wing: path curving from (255,165) to grip near handlebar (405,208); use rotation, or a filled wing shape with tip at (400,208)? More simply: draw wing as a path like a bent arm — from shoulder to handlebar, thick stroke, oval "wingtip" at handlebar. Or draw a wing shape with tip at (400,208).
- Legs: two lines from body (245,215) and (265,215) down to pedal positions. Cranks: lines (295,295)-(280,275) and (295,295)-(310,315). Feet: orange webbed triangles at pedal ends.

Pedals: small rectangles.

Helmet? Could add a cute helmet. Maybe just a small hat. Add a helmet arc above the head for safety's sake — cute detail: orange helmet.

Background: sky light blue, sun, clouds, ground line.

Let me write code:

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 420" width="600" height="420">
Sky rectangle fill #cfe8ff.
Sun circle cx=520 cy=70 r=40 fill #ffd75e.
Clouds: ellipses.
Ground: rect y=350 height=70 fill #a8d5a2; ground line.

Wheels: r=55, y=310? Ground at 365: wheel bottom should touch ground ~365: cy=310, r=55 → bottom is 365. Rear (175,310), front (445,310).

Spokes: 8 lines per wheel: use <g> with rotated lines. Simpler to draw just horizontal/vertical/diagonal lines. Write lines explicitly.

Frame color: #e0492f stroke width 6.

Seat: small ellipse/rectangle at seatpost top.

Handlebar: vertical stem from H (410,235) to (410,205), bar horizontal line (390,205)-(430,200)? Just a horizontal bar at y=205 x395-425, with grips.

Pelican feet: near BB (305,300) on crank.

Check that pelican fits: body ellipse center (245,175) rx48 ry38 — spans y137–213, x197–293. Head circle (310,115) r=22. Neck: path connecting body to head — draw a thick stroke path from (270,140) to (305,130).

Beak: upper line from (322,108) to (398,132); pouch: path M322,120 Q365,175 398,136 ... Beak fill as a single path: M320,105 L398,130 Q360,170 318,128 Z fill orange. Eye at (315,110).

Helmet: path arc above head M288,105 A22,22 ... fill red.

Wing: draw wing as a path from (250,160) to (405,205): quadratic curve M255,165 Q330,140 400,203 — stroke width 14, round cap, color light gray. Plus wingtip at grip.

Legs: line (250,212)→(295,285) orange stroke; foot triangle at (295,285). Second leg partially hidden.

Chain: ellipse-like path from rear hub to BB, skip? Could add chain as a line from rear hub to BB. Keep it simple: crank circle at BB r=8, crank arms.

Pedals at ends of cranks: crank arm (305,305) to (285,285) and (325,325). Feet at (285,285) (near)... let me set BB=(310,305). Cranks: left pedal (290,288), right pedal (330,322). Pelican foot: webbed foot polygon at (290,288).

Frame coords:
- Rear hub (175,310), front hub (445,310), BB (310,305)
- Seat S (235,225): seat tube line BB–S; chainstay R–BB; seatstay R–S.
- Head tube point H (425,230): down tube BB–H, top tube S–H, fork H–F.

Seatpost continues a bit above seat, seat = ellipse (235,222) rx16 ry6 dark.

Handlebar stem: H up to (430,205), horizontal bar (410,205)-(445,205).

Wingtip should reach (420,207). Adjust wing curve: M260,168 Q345,135 418,205 stroke width 16.

Head is (310,115) — beak tip (398,130) above handlebar, fine.

Tail: polygon (197,175) (175,165) (196,195).

Wing feather lines optional.

Motion lines behind bike: speed lines on the left side.

Let me write final SVG. Use groups and comments. Keep reasonable length.

Spoke generation: lines through hub: for wheel (cx,cy): horizontal line cx-45 to cx+45, vertical, two diagonals (±32). Rim: inner circle r=45 stroke. Outer tire r=55 width 6.

Include a shadow ellipse under bike.

Final answer: provide the SVG code block, brief explanation optional.
